rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is the primary join key for one-to-one matching with Acc_Info_dirty and must be populated for all records

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N serves as a unique table-level identifier and one-to-one join key; duplicates would indicate data integrity issues

rule: S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is defined as a one-to-one shared join key with Acc_Info_dirty; referential integrity must be enforced before joining

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier for customer accounts

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits when represented as string
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit identifiers (range 1001-1028 observed); values must conform to 4-character length after type conversion to string

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Customer name is mandatory for identity verification and operational communication

rule: Name must follow Title Case convention except for recognized lowercase particles (bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Evidence shows casing deviations: 'lim wei jie' (all lowercase) and 'WANG SHI JIE' (all uppercase). Standard naming convention requires Title Case while preserving cultural particles in lowercase

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID is mandatory for identity verification in this Singapore-based registry

rule: ID_No must conform to Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one prefix letter (S/T/F/G), followed by exactly 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
rationale: 93.3% of values follow the standard format (e.g., S8403757E). Anomalies like '1916569C' (missing prefix) and 'F212233V' (6 digits) deviate from the required pattern and require validation

rule: Race must not be null
rationale: Race is a mandatory demographic classification field with no missing values observed

rule: Race must be one of the canonical values: Chinese, Malay, Indian
rationale: Evidence shows three semantic categories with casing variations (e.g., 'MALAY', 'malay', 'indian'). Values must conform to standardized set after casing normalization

rule: Gender must not be null
rationale: Gender is a mandatory demographic field with no missing values observed

rule: Gender must be either Male or Female (Title Case)
rationale: Evidence shows two semantic categories with casing inconsistencies ('male', 'FEMALE'). Values must conform to standardized Title Case enumeration

rule: Age must be numeric parseable (no text representations)
rationale: Evidence shows one text representation 'Twenty-five' that cannot be parsed as a number. All age values must be numeric

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint for human age. Evidence shows negative value (-5) which is biologically impossible

rule: Age must be at least 13 years for consumer service accounts
rationale: Evidence indicates values 4 and -5 below age 13, flagged as potentially unrealistic for a service account. This consumer service dataset requires users to be at least 13 years old

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number with 8-digit local number
rationale: Singapore-based organization with country code +65. Local numbers must be exactly 8 digits. Evidence shows one 7-digit value '8964359' which is invalid

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is mandatory for customer contact and account communication; no missing values observed in sample

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
rationale: Evidence shows 4 structurally malformed emails: 'not-an-email' and 'useremail.com' (missing @), 'zx91 @example.com' (contains space), 'nabilah@@example.com' (double @)

rule: Country must not be null
rationale: Country is a mandatory geographic identifier with no missing values observed

rule: Country must be the canonical value 'Singapore'
rationale: All 8 observed variations represent Singapore (e.g., 'Singapura', 'SG', '新加坡', 'S'pore'). Values must be standardized to the canonical English form 'Singapore'

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is mandatory for address completeness and delivery purposes

rule: Street_Name must follow Title Case convention
rationale: Evidence shows one all-uppercase value 'HOLLAND ROAD' which deviates from the dominant Title Case convention observed in other street names

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Street_Name']).split() if len(w) > 1)

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Postal code is mandatory for address validation and mail delivery

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Singapore postal codes are strictly 6 digits. Evidence shows 4-digit (6907) and 5-digit (99999) values indicating truncated leading zeros from integer storage. All values must be 6 characters long when zero-padded

rule: Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column: Bin or s/o indicates Male; Binte or d/o indicates Female
rationale: Malay and Indian naming conventions use specific particles: 'Bin' and 's/o' (son of) indicate male; 'Binte' and 'd/o' (daughter of) indicate female. Mismatches suggest data entry errors

check_params.logic: (re.search(r'\b(Bin|s/o)\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) and row['Gender'].strip().lower() != 'male') or (re.search(r'\b(Binte|d/o)\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) and row['Gender'].strip().lower() != 'female')

rule: Account_No must match the Account_No value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: Account_No is shared between tables and must be consistent for the same customer record identified by S_N

check_params.semantic_check: Account_No values must be identical between Cust_Bio_dirty and Acc_Info_dirty for matching S_N

rule: ID_No must match the ID value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: National ID is shared between tables (ID_No in Cust_Bio_dirty, ID in Acc_Info_dirty) and must be consistent for identity verification

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must match ID exactly for the same S_N across tables

rule: Name must match the Full_Name value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (allowing for standardization differences)
rationale: Customer name appears in both tables (Name in Cust_Bio_dirty, Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty) and must represent the same person identified by S_N

check_params.semantic_check: Name must match Full_Name for the same S_N after normalization (case and whitespace)
